Messages.Author: Joubert
Messages.Body:
If pool is spent on business pressure in such a way that a methuselah
(who already cannot possibly get another VP) self ousts, does the oust
resolve immediately or at the end of the action?

I would say immediately, but if this is the case, is the predator of the
self ousting methuselah able to spend the pool gained from the oust on
the business pressure?

And if the methuselah calling the vote is the one that self ousts, am I
correct in assuming that the vote fizzles?

Thanks,
--Andrew

Business Pressure [Jyhad:R2, VTES:R, Tenth:B]
Cardtype: Action Modifier

Discipline: Presence

Only usable during a referendum.
[pre] Each Methuselah can burn pool to gain votes during the resolution
of this card (resolve this card before moving on). A Methuselah gains 2
votes for each pool he or she burns.
[PRE] As above, but you gain 3 votes for each pool you burn.

> [PRE] As above, but you gain 3 votes for each pool you burn.

I was surprised to see that this is the official text on the website.

This official text is the same as the Jyhad/VTES version of the card,
but different from the 10th anniversary printing.

On the original card (and the above-quoted text), it is implied that the
acting Methuselah gets 3 votes per pool at superior, while other
Methuselahs still only get 2.

The 10th anniversary version of the card says "the Methuselah" instead
of "you". Which implies that, at superior, *everyone* gets 3 votes per
pool.

So which of these is the correct interpretation of the card?

Thanks.
